run_create_voc_data_files: run the script to extract VOC2007/VOC2012 dataset files and labels from annotations for training
run_validate_files: run validate_files to filter input files keeping only those matching the class_name_split.txt naming pattern
run_get_data_files: run get_data_files to retrieve train/test/val annotation files from ImageSets/Main for a given split
run_get_images_labels_info: run get_images_labels_info to build image paths and label vectors from VOC annotation files for a split
run_main_cli: run the CLI with --data_source_dir and --output_dir to generate numpy and optional JSON data files for VOC partitions
